selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What happened to the traveller’s faith and inner understanding as he kept reading the signs in the universe?
questions.answer: His faith became stronger, his spiritual understanding grew, and his certainty in Allah increased.

questions.question: According to the passage, why did the traveller ask for more after listening to the lessons of the sky, space, and earth?
questions.answer: He was so pleased and convinced by what he had learned that his joy and desire to keep learning became stronger.

questions.question: What new source of signs did the traveller begin to listen to after the sky, space, and earth?
questions.answer: He turned to the seas and the great rivers.

questions.question: How are the sounds of the seas and rivers described?
questions.answer: They are described as deeply moving, with a tone that is both sorrowful and pleasing.

questions.question: What were the seas and rivers inviting the traveller to do?
questions.answer: They were calling him to observe them and reflect on the meanings they point to.

questions.question: What natural qualities of the seas are emphasized in the passage?
questions.answer: Their constant movement, strong energy, joining together, and pouring behavior are emphasized.

questions.question: Even though the seas move with the earth at great speed, what important limit do they not cross?
questions.answer: They do not spill over wildly or take over the nearby land.

questions.question: What conclusion does the traveller reach from the fact that the seas stay within bounds despite their power and motion?
questions.answer: He concludes that they are being controlled and protected by a being of immense power and greatness.

questions.question: What is the main shift in the traveller’s journey at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: He moves from reflecting on earlier parts of the universe to studying the signs shown through the seas and rivers.

questions.question: Which inner qualities increase together in the traveller during this stage of reflection?
questions.answer: His faith, spiritual knowledge, belief in Allah, happiness, and eagerness all increase.

questions.question: In what way do the seas and rivers communicate with the traveller?
questions.answer: They seem to speak through their sounds and conditions, directing him to examine the signs within them.

questions.question: What feature of the seas makes their restraint especially striking?
questions.answer: They are in powerful, continuous motion and move together with the earth very rapidly, yet they still remain under control.

questions.question: What does the passage imply by saying the seas neither scatter nor invade the land beside them?
questions.answer: It implies that their behavior is not random but held in order by divine control.

questions.question: What two opposite states of the seas are mentioned together, and why is that meaningful?
questions.answer: Their moving and their staying still are both mentioned, showing that every condition of the seas is governed.

questions.question: How does the passage use observation of nature to point to belief in Allah?
questions.answer: It presents order, limits, and protection in nature as evidence of a deliberate and powerful ruler.

questions.question: What attributes of the one who governs the seas are highlighted at the end of the target passage?
questions.answer: Supreme power and majesty are highlighted.

questions.question: What effect did reading the pages of the universe have on the traveller’s belief in Allah?
questions.answer: It raised his belief to a higher level and made it more developed.

questions.question: How is faith described in relation to human happiness in the passage?
questions.answer: It is presented as a key that opens the way to true happiness.

questions.question: How is deeper recognition of divine truth described in relation to spiritual growth?
questions.answer: It is described as a means that opens the way to spiritual advancement.

questions.question: After hearing the teachings of the heavens and the earth, what emotional response did the traveller show?
questions.answer: He became more joyful and eager, and he called out for more.

questions.question: What part of creation answered his desire for more signs?
questions.answer: The seas and the large rivers answered it.

questions.question: What did the traveller notice first when he looked at the seas?
questions.answer: He noticed their living, ceaseless movement and the force built into their nature.

questions.question: What is remarkable about the seas in relation to the land?
questions.answer: Although they are huge and active, they do not cross their limits and swallow the land next to them.

questions.question: What belief about the world is rejected by the way the passage describes the seas?
questions.answer: It rejects the idea that nature runs on its own without a ruling will.
